quarterly_data.quarter: Lumentum press release: Lumentum, Astera Labs, and Corning to Demonstrate 1060 nm (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Joint demonstration at the 2026 OCP Global Summit (a proof-of-concept, not a shipping product): Lumentum, Astera Labs and Corning announced a rack-level demonstration of PCIe-over-optics connectivity for AI racks that combines an Astera Labs Scorpio Smart Fabric Switch with Lumentum's 1060 nm VCSEL-based optical interconnect platform and Corning multimode fiber. The optical engine uses high-density 1060 nm VCSEL and photodetector arrays with advanced packaging (two-dimensional arrays with backside lens technology) and is built on Lumentum's ultra-high-volume 3D sensing manufacturing platform for smartphone devices; the system is designed to demonstrate multiple 32 Gb/s NRZ optical channels over multimode fiber and an error-free PCIe-5 link. CTO Matt Sysak: the demonstration 'shows how Lumentum's 1060 nm VCSEL platform can extend PCIe connectivity and unlock a whole new class of functionality.'
quarterly_data.figure: 1060 nm VCSEL; multiple 32 Gb/s NRZ optical channels; error-free PCIe-5 link (proof-of-concept)
